newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Corp to delay New York listing - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Corp to delay New York listing - paper.

text.p: Trading house Mitsubishi Corp will delay listing its shares on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE), which it originally planned for 1998, a Japanese business daily said on Monday.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said that the trading house thought it had not yet raised its return on equity to a level where it would be attractive to investors in the United States.
Mitsubishi Corp originally planned to apply for a listing in 1997 to offer its shares on the NYSE in 1998, the paper said.

The trading house still intends to list its shares in New York, but the listing will probably not be included in the company's next business plan to cover the three years from the business year from April 1, 1998, the paper said.
Mitsubishi Corp spokesmen were not immediately available for comment on the report.
